{{Quote|So good, you'd swear they were made by the Soup People of Tureen VI.|The menu of Dex's Diner|<ref name="Dex's" />}}
The '''Soup People''' were a group known for producing high-quality [[Soup/Legends|soups]]. They [[Homeworld/Legends|hailed]] from the astronomical object [[Tureen VI]],<ref name="Dex's" /> which was located in the [[Tureen system/Legends|Tureen system]] in the [[Kriz sector/Legends|Kriz sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="TEAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Tureen system/Legends|Tureen system]]</ref> [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]], who owned the [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurant]] on the<ref name="Dex's" /> [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]<ref name="Core">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], claimed in his diner's menu,<ref name="Dex's" /> at some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]],<ref name="DexDates">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/dexdiner/index.html|text=Dining at Dex's|int=Dining at Dex's}} is set at some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]] per the {{DiningAtDexDate}}.</ref> that he served soup of the same quality as that of the Soup People.<ref name="Dex's" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Silly, but it works as a throwaway reference.|Gregory Walker, on the Soup People of Tureen VI|<ref name="blog">{{Blog|narbflick|11|Dining at Dex's: The Story Behind the Story}}</ref>}}
The Soup People of Tureen VI were introduced in "[[Dining at Dex's]]," a [[2009]] [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]]-exclusive article written by [[Gregory Walker]] in the form of an [[in-universe]] menu.<ref name="Dex's" /> In his [[Star Wars: Blogs|blog]], Walker called the Soup People a silly throwaway reference,<ref name="blog" /> as a [[Wikipedia:Tureen|tureen]] is a dish used to hold soup.<ref name="Tureen">{{WebCite|url=https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/tureen|text=Tureen definition|work=[[Wikipedia:Merriam-Webster|Merriam-Webster]]|archivedate=20210421043617}}</ref>
